## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue or specification when relevant.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explain untested behavior or limits.

## Hardware and compatibility impact

State whether this changes hardware behavior, firmware assumptions, report schemas,
or the frozen driver. If none, say so. If applicable, link the reviewed design and
evidence; CI passing does not lift the hardware hold.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] Target-folder licensing and SPDX requirements are satisfied.
- [ ] Documentation or fixtures reflect any changed behavior.
- [ ] No raw private captures, credentials, vendor binaries or recovered source are included.
